confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from an RBA search result dated 2026-11-18, showing 0.6720 USD per AUD. Food and drink anchors come from one web search of cost-of-living aggregators (Numbeo-style sites such as Traveltables, Livingcost and Mylifeelsewhere). Their figures differ and some are dated or crowdsourced. One source gave an implausibly low mid-range meal for two, so I disregarded it. I found no cocktail or restaurant wine-by-the-glass prices. I estimated cocktail at about 2x the beer price and wine glass at about 1x the beer price, based on typical Italian pricing. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for July peak season. I did not check any booking pages or listings, so they are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Palermo is a southern Italian city with lower prices than Rome, Florence or Venice. Its peak-season accommodation is similar to Naples and Catania, with some summer tourism uplift.
